import { test, it, expect, afterAll, aroundEach } from 'vitest';
import { appendFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { hookEnabled } from './mode.mjs';
import { body } from './body.mjs';
writeFileSync('events.jsonl', '');
const clock = Date.now();
const event = kind => appendFileSync('events.jsonl', JSON.stringify({ kind, ms: Date.now() - clock }) + '\n');
const sleep = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
if (hookEnabled) aroundEach(async run => await run());
const extended = test.extend({
  unusedSlow: [async ({}, use) => {
    event('auto-fixture-setup-start');
    await sleep(300);
    event('auto-fixture-setup-done');
    await use('unused-value');
    event('auto-fixture-teardown');
  }, { auto: true }],
});
extended('[REQ-393][AF01] unused auto fixture exceeds test timeout', { timeout: 100 }, async ({ task, onTestFinished }) => {
  event('test-body');
  return body({ task, onTestFinished }, () => { event('body-fn'); expect(1).toBe(1); });
});
it('[REQ-393][Z99] settle pending fixture setup', { timeout: 1000 }, async () => {
  event('settle-start');
  await sleep(500);
  event('settle-done');
});
afterAll(() => event('after-all'));
